verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the Danube river promenade, a 15-minute walk from the historic Old Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: Positioned on the vibrant Danube river promenade, a scenic 15-minute walk from the historic Old Town

verified_facts.text: The riverside promenade offers a direct pedestrian connection to the historic city center and suits jogging, strolling or cycling.
verified_facts.excerpt: The scenic promenade is perfect for a morning jog, a leisurely sunset stroll, or a bike ride, offering refreshing views and a direct pedestrian connection to the historical city center.

verified_facts.text: ZION SPA Luxury on the 11th floor has panoramic Danube views, bespoke treatments, a pool, hot tubs, saunas and a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: ZION SPA Luxury, located on the 11th floor, offers panoramic Danube views, bespoke treatments, a pool, hot tubs, saunas, a steam room, and signature wellness rituals.

verified_facts.text: The indoor pool on the 11th floor has hydro massage, bubble loungers and a jacuzzi with panoramic views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The indoor swimming pool has hydro massage and bubble loungers and a jacuzzi with panoramic views of the surrounding area from the 11th floor perch.

verified_facts.text: Rooms start at 35 square meters and include high-speed wireless internet, a mini-bar and individually controlled air conditioning.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spanning 35 square meters or more, each spacious room features wireless high-speed internet, a mini-bar, and individually controlled air conditioning.

verified_facts.text: Every suite, from the Junior Suite to the Presidential Suite, has Danube views and access to ZION Spa Luxury.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the intimate Junior Suite to the grand Presidential Suite, each offers elegant design, stunning Danube views, and exclusive access to Zion Spa Luxury.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has handwoven Persian carpets and a bathroom with 24-karat gold tiles, onyx and black marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: Handwoven Persian carpets grace the floors, while the opulent bathroom boasts 24-karat gold tiles, onyx, and sleek black marble.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a 75-square-meter terrace with views of Bratislava and the Danube.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Presidential Suite features a stunning 75 sq m terrace offering a unique view of Bratislava, the Danube River, and the picturesque surroundings of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Guests can arrive via the hotel's private rooftop heliport or private river pier.
verified_facts.excerpt: For an extraordinary arrival, utilize private rooftop heliport or private river pier.

verified_facts.text: The glass wine cellar at the Lobby Lounge holds more than 300 Slovak and international wines and is the biggest hotel wine cellar in Slovakia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Impressive glass wine cellar at Lobby Lounge offers more than 300 fine Slovak and international wines and is the biggest hotel wine cellar in Slovakia.

verified_facts.text: Both restaurants have outdoor terraces overlooking the Danube.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both of our beautiful restaurants in Bratislava have relaxed outdoor terraces with stunning views over the famous Danube River.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange a private speedboat tour on the Danube.
verified_facts.excerpt: Let our Concierge arrange a private speedboat tour for you.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Living Room lounge on the 9th floor is a space to relax or work.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the exclusive Grand Living Room on the 9th floor, offering a sophisticated space to relax or work in comfort.

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms and suites are available for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideal for families, featuring connecting rooms and suites for ultimate comfort.

verified_facts.text: Suites have marble bathrooms with rainfall showers and bathtubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury suites in Slovakia feature marble bathrooms with rainfall showers and bathtubs.

verified_facts.text: The top-floor gym has Danube views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our top-floor hotel gym offers Danube views and state-of-the-art equipment.
